critique: The render reads cleanly as an FPGA NTT accelerator card: eight blue interleaved BRAM banks line the −X edge, the copper DSP-multiplier column and dark/steel symmetric add/sub pairs sit in an open framed array, the three routing layers (read/return/twiddle) and their arrows are legible in TOP, and both exploded views (radix-4 BU and ten-fin heatsink) lift cleanly off the die — no floating parts or ground violations in FRONT/SIDE. Geometry is essentially mature; the binding defect is fidelity, not form. The carried-over verifier finding is correct and unaddressed in the prose: the asserted headline conflict-free map b(i)=(i+(i>>3)) mod 8 provably COLLIDES for radix-2 strides 2^6..2^9 (b(i+2^s)=b(i) there), so the scene was overclaiming its central contribution; the exact crossbar permutation, twiddle-ROM addressing, DIT/DIF convention and per-stage FSM cycle counts are reproduction guesses, not transcribed from CFNTT Sec. III, and cannot be recovered without the source PDF.
